overview.brief: Dark jungle/swamp around Oggok and the Temple of Cazic-Thule; connects also toward Rathe Mountains, Innothule, and Plane of Fear. Lizard men, spiders, alligators, undead, and spectres. EQ Legends Tools recommends 1–9 (page title: Feerrott).
